name: Jeush (Son of Esau)
title: Chieftain of Edom
summary: Jeush was a son of Esau and his wife Oholibamah, daughter of Anah. He became a chieftain in the land of Edom and was part of Esau's descendants who settled in the Seir mountains. He represents one of the tribes that made up the Edomite people.

keyEvents.title: The Birth of Jeush
keyEvents.description: Jeush was born as the son of Esau and Oholibamah in the land of Canaan, as part of Esau's growing family.

keyEvents.title: Esau's Family Moves Away from Jacob
keyEvents.description: Esau took his wives, sons, daughters, and all his household and moved to another land, away from his brother Jacob, because the land could not support them both.

keyEvents.title: Jeush mentioned among Esau's sons born in Canaan
keyEvents.description: Jeush is listed among Esau's sons who were born in the land of Canaan, as part of the genealogy of Esau's descendants.

keyEvents.title: Jeush becomes a tribal chief in Edom
keyEvents.description: Jeush was appointed as a tribal chief among Oholibamah's sons and was one of the princes in the land of Edom, demonstrating his prominent role in Edomite society.

keyEvents.title: Esau's genealogy in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Jeush is mentioned in Chronicles as part of the extensive genealogy that begins with Abraham, confirming his place in biblical history.
